Yuchen Zhou

PhD Student

GRASP Lab, University of Pennsylvania

I'm Yuchen Zhou, a PhD student at the University of Pennsylvania, advised by Prof. Jiayuan Mao. My research lies at the intersection of robotics and machine learning, with a focus on developing algorithms that enable robots to learn efficiently. I earned my bachelor's degree from Tsinghua University and my master's degree from the University of California, San Diego.
